title: What Kind of Lover Are You?

plan.title: What you have plenty of, and what you lack
How you fight, and how you make up
How you show love, and how you need it shown

strong.text:
Your chart is the strong kind, {dm_short}, which changes the speed of all this. Strong charts fall with conviction. Once you've decided someone is worth it, you commit to the feeling and start building, sometimes before the other person has finished deciding anything. That confidence is attractive. It can also leave a partner feeling recruited rather than courted.

A useful habit: in the first month, ask more questions than you answer. What do they want their life to look like? What did their last relationship teach them? You'll fall just as hard, but you'll fall toward the actual person instead of the one your certainty sketched in on the first date.

There's also a timing trick that suits strong charts. Decide nothing big in the first six weeks: no moving in, no meeting every relative, no announcing it to the group chat as definitely the one. Not because the feeling is wrong, but because your certainty arrives before the evidence does. Six weeks lets the evidence catch up. If it's real, it'll still be real, and you'll have chosen it with your eyes open.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You decided on date one. They were still reading the menu. Slow down a little.

weak.text:
Your chart is the weak kind, {dm_short}, which changes how all this feels from inside. Weak charts often fall through relief. Someone is kind, attentive, steady, and the relief of being chosen feels exactly like attraction. Sometimes it is. Sometimes it's gratitude wearing a nicer outfit.

A useful habit: before you fall all the way, notice whether you like who you are around them. Are you funnier, calmer, more yourself? Or more careful, more agreeable, slightly smaller? The right match leaves you feeling more like yourself, not just less alone. Both feelings are warm. Only one of them lasts.

One more check helps. Look at how you feel the morning after a date, not during it. During, everything is warm. The morning after tells the truth: rested and light, or anxious and replaying every sentence. A weak chart deserves love that leaves it calmer than before. If you keep waking up tense, that's information, however lovely the evenings were.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Being chosen feels great. Check you actually choose them back.

base.how-you-fall: You don't fall, you decide. Somewhere around the third conversation you look at a person and think, yes, this one is worth building something with, and from then on you are all in. Gap is the tall tree, and trees don't wander off to see what else is growing. The catch is that your decision often comes before the other person has made theirs. You can mistake your own certainty for proof that it's mutual. You also fall for potential. You see who someone could become in five years and you love that version a little too early. When it works, it's beautiful: steady, loyal, protective love that makes people feel chosen. When it doesn't, you stay far longer than the evidence allows, because leaving feels like admitting you planted in the wrong field.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Gap, you love like a promise. Steady, loyal, the person everyone wishes they'd dated first.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Also the person who turns a second date into a five-year development plan.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: That's devotion! Love the person in front of you, Gap, not the five-year plan.

spring.intro:
Spring is Wood's own season, so a spring-born Gap Wood arrives in love already at full height. You are the tree in April, growing in every direction at once, and when you fall you fall with a plan. You decide early, you say it plainly, and you expect the other person to keep up. That confidence is gorgeous on a first date and exhausting by month three if nobody pushes back. In-season Wood has plenty of drive and very little give, so your love lesson is pruning, which in saju is Metal's job. A partner with clear edges, who says no and means it, does not shrink you. They give your growth a shape worth looking at.

Spring-born lovers tend to fall at the start of things: new jobs, new cities, new seasons. Notice whether you love the person or the fresh start they arrived with.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Spring Gap, you planted a whole orchard on date two. Let them see one tree first.

summer.intro:
Summer belongs to Fire, and Wood is what Fire burns, so a summer-born Gap Wood spends itself keeping everyone warm. In love you are the generous one: the planner, the driver, the person who books the table and remembers which seat they like. You give shade and fuel without being asked, and people fall for how safe that feels. The catch is that a tree in July dries out. You pour into a relationship until you notice, quite suddenly, that nobody has watered you in weeks, and then you go silent instead of saying so. Water is your resource element, which in love means being looked after and letting someone else carry the plan for once.

Summer-born lovers tend to love at full volume. Pace yourself, because the best relationships for you are the ones that stay warm in winter too.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Summer Gap, you give everyone shade. Sit under someone else's tree this time. You've earned it.

autumn.intro:
Autumn belongs to Metal, and Metal is the axe that cuts Wood. Born in autumn, a Gap Wood grows up under pressure, which makes you one of the most disciplined lovers of the ten. You do not fall carelessly. You test, you measure, you check whether this person will still respect you after the first argument. Being shaped by Metal makes you loyal and honest, but it also makes you brace for criticism before any arrives. You can hear a small comment about your plans as a verdict on your worth. The right person for you is not soft or vague. They are direct and warm in the same sentence, so the cut feels like care, not judgment.

Autumn-born lovers tend to be selective and slow to commit, then deeply loyal. Let people earn your trust, but don't make the test impossible.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Autumn Gap, not every 'are you sure?' is an attack. Sometimes they just want the details.

winter.intro:
Winter is Water's season, and Water feeds Wood, so a winter-born Gap Wood has deep roots and a cold canopy. You have plenty of inner support, ideas, memory and patience, but the warmth that makes a tree blossom is in short supply. In love that looks like a slow, sincere start. You might like someone for months while appearing completely neutral. Once you commit, you are steady through anything, the kind of partner who turns up in February with a spare umbrella and no complaints. What you need is warmth: someone who laughs easily, says the affectionate thing out loud, and pulls you into the sun. Your cool exterior is not a lack of feeling. It is just midwinter.

Winter-born lovers tend to love quietly and deeply. Say it out loud more often than feels necessary. It rarely is too often.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Winter Gap, you've liked them since October. Maybe mention it before the blossoms do.

earth.intro:
The Earth days close a season, and you arrived in them, Gap. A tall tree in heavy ground: Wood controls Earth, so in love you tend to take charge of the practical side. You plan dates, solve problems, and show affection by building something together. That's a real kind of devotion. The risk is that love becomes a to-do list and your person feels managed rather than adored. Late-season Gap needs a partner who can just sit in the field with you. Leave one evening a week unplanned.

Lovers born in the Earth days tend to be the steady one in every relationship. Make sure someone is steadying you, too.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Gap, the best date might be the one with no plan at all.

base.how-you-fall: You fall sideways. Eul is the vine and the wildflower, and vines don't charge at things, they wind. One day you're just friends, the next you've memorized their coffee order, their sister's name and the exact playlist that fixes their bad days, and you realize you've been falling for weeks. You attach through closeness and small daily contact. Texting good morning, sharing memes, borrowing their hoodie. It's gentle and it's sneaky, even to you. The beauty of this is that your love feels natural and easy, never forced. The risk is that you can wrap yourself around a person before you've checked whether they're a strong trellis or a wobbly fence post. You adapt to fit them so well that it's hard to tell, later, which parts of you were yours.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Eul, you love like a vine. Gentle, close, woven into every little part of their day.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: And by month three you've adopted their music taste, their friends and their opinions on cilantro.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You're just so adaptable! People feel completely seen by you.

spring.intro:
Spring-born Eul Wood is the vine in full bloom, in season and very aware of it. You flirt the way flowers open, gradually and then all at once, and you are excellent at reading what the other person wants and becoming the version of you that fits. That adaptability makes you easy to fall for. In love, though, an Eul born in spring can wrap around a person until neither of you remembers where you end. You don't grip like Gap. You twine. Metal, the element that controls Wood, is your teacher here: a clear boundary, a separate weekend, an opinion you keep even when theirs is louder. Flowers need a trellis, not another flower.

Spring-born lovers tend to fall at the start of things: new jobs, new cities, new seasons. Notice whether you love the person or the fresh start they arrived with.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Spring Eul, you agreed with their music, their politics and their opinion of their ex. Pick one.

summer.intro:
In summer, Fire takes the wheel and Wood becomes its fuel, so a summer-born Eul Wood gives off a lot of light for a delicate plant. You are charming in a sunny, sociable way: the person who sends the funny voice note, remembers their best friend's birthday, and makes every date photogenic. You express love generously and visibly. The trouble with summer flowers is that they droop in the afternoon heat. You can give so much attention that you feel quietly empty, then start keeping score in your head instead of asking for what you need. Water is your resource, and in love it looks like reassurance. Ask for it directly. Drooping hints never work as well as words.

Summer-born lovers tend to love at full volume. Pace yourself, because the best relationships for you are the ones that stay warm in winter too.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Summer Eul, you water everyone else's garden. Saying 'I'd love a little attention' is allowed.

autumn.intro:
Autumn is Metal's season, and Metal cuts Wood. For a delicate Eul Wood, that means arriving in a season of pruning, so you learned early to bend instead of breaking. In love you are perceptive and careful. You notice the tone of a text before you notice the words, and you adapt fast to keep the peace. Many autumn Eul lovers end up with someone strong, decisive, a little bossy, and call it chemistry. Sometimes it is. Sometimes it is a familiar pressure. The question for you is not whether you can survive someone's sharp edges. You obviously can. It is whether you should have to. Partners who are gentle and firm at once do exist.

Autumn-born lovers tend to be selective and slow to commit, then deeply loyal. Let people earn your trust, but don't make the test impossible.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Autumn Eul, 'they're intense but they mean well' is not a love language. It's an excuse.

winter.intro:
Winter hands command to Water. It nourishes Wood, but frost is hard on a flowering vine, so a winter-born Eul Wood is resourceful, observant and slightly guarded. You read people beautifully, sometimes too beautifully, and you can talk yourself out of a crush before it starts because you have already imagined the ending. Your love is patient. You will wait out a slow season with someone and stay soft while you do it. What you lack is sun. Fire, your output element, shows up as play, flirting, being a little silly on purpose. Someone warm and openly affectionate thaws you faster than any amount of logic, and you deserve love that feels like a sunny windowsill.

Winter-born lovers tend to love quietly and deeply. Say it out loud more often than feels necessary. It rarely is too often.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Winter Eul, you're not cold. You're waiting for someone warm enough. Let them find the window.

earth.intro:
Born in the Earth days, Eul, you're a vine growing over firm ground. Wood controls Earth, so you love by weaving yourself into someone's life: their routines, their friends, their favorite places. It's tender, and it's quietly strategic. You get close without ever asking for closeness. The risk is that you lose your own shape inside theirs. You need a partner who notices what you want before you've adapted away from it. Tell them, early and plainly.

Lovers born in the Earth days tend to be the steady one in every relationship. Make sure someone is steadying you, too.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Eul, you blend in so well they forget to ask what you'd like. Tell them.

base.how-you-fall: You fall fast and in public. Byeong is the sun, and the sun has never once been subtle. When you like someone, everyone knows by Friday, including your group chat, your mom and possibly the barista. You fall for energy: someone who laughs at your jokes, who matches your enthusiasm, who makes ordinary nights feel like an event. The first weeks with you are a highlight reel. Spontaneous plans, big gestures, you making them feel like the most interesting person in any room. The tricky part comes when the shine settles into routine. You love loving, and you can mistake a quiet phase for a dying flame. It usually isn't. Real warmth doesn't need to be at full brightness all the time. Even the sun has evenings.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Byeong, you love like sunshine. Big, warm, generous. Everyone feels invited.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Exactly. Everyone. Including the person you're not dating. They're confused.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You're just naturally warm! Your first dates are legendary.

spring.intro:
Spring is Wood's season, and Wood feeds Fire, so a spring-born Byeong Fire is the rising sun with a full tank. You fall quickly and optimistically, convinced every new crush might be the big one, and your enthusiasm is honestly contagious. You love courting: the plans, the surprises, the long walks that turn into long talks. With so much fuel behind you, the risk is that you burn through the beginning and then wonder why the middle feels flat. Your love grows when you aim the light instead of spraying it. Choose one person, one plan, one honest conversation. Earth, the element your Fire feeds, is your lesson: turn a spark into something people can stand on.

Spring-born lovers tend to fall at the start of things: new jobs, new cities, new seasons. Notice whether you love the person or the fresh start they arrived with.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Spring Byeong, you said 'soulmate' after brunch. Let it be a Tuesday before it's destiny.

summer.intro:
Summer is Fire's own season, so a summer-born Byeong is the noon sun: blazing, generous and slightly too much. Everyone feels your warmth, and that is the issue in love. Your partner may adore your brightness and still feel like one of many people basking in it. You crave reaction. When affection goes quiet, you turn up the volume with bigger gestures, louder jokes, a busier calendar. Balance, for a sun this bright, means listening without performing and showing up in plain ways. The most romantic thing you can do is sit still, phone face down, and let them be the interesting one for an evening.

Summer-born lovers tend to love at full volume. Pace yourself, because the best relationships for you are the ones that stay warm in winter too.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Summer Byeong, they don't need fireworks nightly. They need you, at normal brightness, staying.

autumn.intro:
In autumn Metal rules, and Fire controls Metal. A sun setting over a harvest field works hard for what it gets, so an autumn-born Byeong Fire loves through effort. You are the partner who fixes things, organizes the trip, brings home the good bread. You treat love as something you earn, and you are generous with the earnings. Spending your heat on outcomes can leave you tired and quietly resentful when the effort is not matched. Wood, your fuel element, is what refills you: inspiration, encouragement, someone who believes in you before you have done anything impressive. Let yourself be loved for showing up, not just for what you produce.

Autumn-born lovers tend to be selective and slow to commit, then deeply loyal. Let people earn your trust, but don't make the test impossible.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Autumn Byeong, you don't have to fix their week to be loved this week. Just sit down.

winter.intro:
Winter belongs to Water, and Water puts out Fire. Born in winter, a Byeong is the low December sun: rare, precious, and working to be felt. You might be the warmest person in your friend group and still feel unsure whether your love is welcome. That makes you try hard in romance. You overextend early, then retreat when you sense the slightest chill. People treasure your warmth precisely because the season is cold, so you are often more loved than you think. Wood feeds you, and in love that means a partner who encourages you, plans with you and says 'I'm glad you're here.' Pick someone who adds kindling, not someone who tests your flame.

Winter-born lovers tend to love quietly and deeply. Say it out loud more often than feels necessary. It rarely is too often.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Winter Byeong, a little sun in December means more than a whole July. You're that sun.

earth.intro:
You were born in the Earth days, Byeong, when the sun pours warmth into ground that holds it. Fire feeds Earth, so you love by giving: attention, energy, enthusiasm, the full spotlight. Your person feels like the center of the world. The risk is that you give faster than you receive, and the glow turns into tiredness you won't admit. You need someone who warms you back without being asked. Let them plan the next date. Notice how it feels to be the one looked after.

Lovers born in the Earth days tend to be the steady one in every relationship. Make sure someone is steadying you, too.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You light everybody up, Byeong. Let someone light you up for once.

base.how-you-fall: You fall slowly and then completely. Jeong is the candle, and candles don't light up a stadium, they light up a face across a small table. You need a real conversation, the kind that goes past midnight and somehow turns into talking about your childhood, before anything in you moves. Once it does, you feel it intensely. You remember everything: the song playing when they first held your hand, the exact phrasing of their text. Your love is intimate, observant and deeply personal. People who are loved by you feel understood in a way they rarely have before. The risk is that you can fall for the inner world you've imagined in someone, filling silences with meaning they didn't intend. Check in with the real person, not just the beautiful version in your head.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Jeong, you love like candlelight. Close, warm, and so attentive it feels like being read.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: And you remember every single thing they did wrong. With dates.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: That's just how deeply you care! You notice everything.

spring.intro:
With Wood in command and Wood feeding Fire, a spring-born Jeong Fire is a lamp with plenty of oil. Your love is focused and devoted: you choose one person and illuminate every detail of them. You remember the song from the first date and the name of their childhood dog. That attention makes people feel deeply seen. With so much support behind your flame, the risk is intensity. You can analyze a relationship until it becomes a project, reading meaning into every pause. Something practical is the answer here: practical rituals, shared routines, something you build together rather than examine. Let the candle light the room instead of scorching one spot.

Spring-born lovers tend to fall at the start of things: new jobs, new cities, new seasons. Notice whether you love the person or the fresh start they arrived with.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Spring Jeong, you reread their text eleven times. It said 'ok'. It means ok.

summer.intro:
In summer, Fire is everywhere, so a summer-born Jeong Fire is a candle burning at noon. You have plenty of heat, but you constantly compare your glow with the bigger lights around you. In love, that shows up as a quiet competitiveness. You notice who your partner laughs with, who texts them, who they follow. It is not jealousy exactly, more a worry about fading into the brightness. Same-element Fire is a rival as well as a friend in saju. What calms you: a steady partner who chooses you plainly and does not play games. Your light is not smaller. It is closer, and close light is the one people read by.

Summer-born lovers tend to love at full volume. Pace yourself, because the best relationships for you are the ones that stay warm in winter too.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Summer Jeong, you don't have to outshine the room. You're the light they read by.

autumn.intro:
Autumn is Metal's season, and Fire controls Metal. A candle in autumn is the smith's flame, steadily shaping something precious, so an autumn-born Jeong lover works carefully on what they love. You are the person who refines a relationship: talking through conflict, remembering what went wrong last time, adjusting. That commitment is rare and lovely. It is also tiring, because you are spending your heat on improving someone else. Wood is what feeds you, and in romance that means admiration, curiosity about your inner world, someone who asks you questions back. You do not need a project partner. You need someone who wants to know what you are thinking at 2am.

Autumn-born lovers tend to be selective and slow to commit, then deeply loyal. Let people earn your trust, but don't make the test impossible.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Autumn Jeong, they're a person, not a renovation. Stop sanding their edges and let them love you.

winter.intro:
Water commands winter, and Water controls Fire. Born in winter, a Jeong Fire is the candle in a cold window: small, steady and the most welcome thing on the street. You love quietly and loyally, and you guard your flame because you know how easily it can be blown out. In romance that means slow trust. You may test someone with small disclosures before you let them see the real warmth. When they pass, your devotion is extraordinary. When they fail, you close the shutters without a word. Wood, your resource, looks like a partner who is consistent and encouraging. Choose someone who cups their hands around the flame instead of breathing on it.

Winter-born lovers tend to love quietly and deeply. Say it out loud more often than feels necessary. It rarely is too often.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Winter Jeong, the right person will shelter your little flame. You don't have to hide it.

earth.intro:
Earth days are the last weeks of a season, and you were born in them, Jeong. A candle in a clay room, warming the space it's in. You love quietly and thoroughly: the remembered detail, the right song, the safe evening. Fire feeds Earth, so much of your care disappears into making things comfortable, and you rarely ask for credit. The risk is that your person never sees how much you're doing. You need someone who notices small warmth and names it. Show them where to look.

Lovers born in the Earth days tend to be the steady one in every relationship. Make sure someone is steadying you, too.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Jeong, subtle is lovely. Too subtle is invisible.

base.how-you-fall: Your way of falling is like a mountain moves: very slowly, and then it's permanent. Mu is the big hill, the boulder, the thing you can lean against without checking. You don't do impulsive crushes. You observe someone for a long time, quietly gathering evidence that they're trustworthy, consistent and worth the effort of letting in. By the time you show interest, you've basically already decided. That means rejection hits harder than you'd ever show. On the bright side, when you choose someone, they feel deeply safe. You become their shelter: the person who drives over in the rain, fixes the shelf, remembers the doctor appointment. The risk is that you're so focused on being solid that your partner might not realize you're also falling, because mountains don't exactly blush.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Mu, you love like a mountain. Solid, protective, the safest place anyone's ever stood.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Also about as emotionally chatty as a mountain.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Your love is in actions! You drive over in the rain.

spring.intro:
Wood owns the spring, and Wood controls Earth, so a spring-born Mu Earth is a mountain with roots pushing through every crack. You grew up feeling pulled by other people's growth, and in love you are often the steady one everyone leans on. You fall slowly and seriously, and you can mistake being needed for being loved. Partners who are restless or ambitious find you irresistible, because you hold still while they flourish. The pressure of the season makes you sturdy, not stiff. What strengthens you is Fire, your resource: warmth, praise, someone who notices your effort without being told. Being the mountain is lovely. Being admired as one is better.

Spring-born lovers tend to fall at the start of things: new jobs, new cities, new seasons. Notice whether you love the person or the fresh start they arrived with.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Spring Mu, 'they rely on me' and 'they love me' are two separate sentences. Check which.

summer.intro:
Summer is Fire's season, and Fire feeds Earth, so a summer-born Mu Earth is a sun-warmed mountain: solid, generous and difficult to move. You love with full confidence. Once you have chosen someone, you consider the matter settled, which is wonderful for stability and a little alarming for spontaneity. With so much support behind you, your blind spot is assuming your way is the sensible way. You can turn down every new idea by calmly listing reasons, and the person you love stops suggesting things. Metal, the element you produce, is your growth edge: expressing what you feel, not just what you think. Say 'I missed you' out loud. Mountains can echo.

Summer-born lovers tend to love at full volume. Pace yourself, because the best relationships for you are the ones that stay warm in winter too.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Summer Mu, you're the safest place they know. Now say one soft thing out loud today.

autumn.intro:
Metal owns the autumn, and Earth produces Metal, so an autumn-born Mu Earth spends itself making something valuable. You are the mountain full of ore: you give gifts, solutions and practical care, and you rarely ask for anything in return. In love, that looks like quiet acts of service. You will drive across town at midnight but struggle to say what is bothering you. Over time, giving so much drains the reserves, and you can become heavy or withdrawn without explaining why. Fire, your resource, is how you refill: being appreciated, being made a fuss of, a partner who notices when you are worn out before you announce it.

Autumn-born lovers tend to be selective and slow to commit, then deeply loyal. Let people earn your trust, but don't make the test impossible.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Autumn Mu, you fixed their shelf, their car and their résumé. Did anyone ask how you are?

winter.intro:
Winter is Water's season, and Earth controls Water, so a winter-born Mu Earth is a frozen mountain holding back a lake. You have a lot of feeling stored up and a strong instinct to manage it. In love you are reliable and patient, but you can be slow to warm, and your partner might wonder what is happening beneath the snow. You see love as responsibility: keeping things stable, avoiding drama, looking after the practical side. The cold season makes Fire precious for you. Laughter, affection, a partner who drags you to a lively dinner. Warmth is not a distraction from commitment. For a winter mountain, it is the thing that lets spring come.

Winter-born lovers tend to love quietly and deeply. Say it out loud more often than feels necessary. It rarely is too often.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Winter Mu, you hold so much in. Let one warm person past the snowline.

earth.intro:
Born in the Earth days, Mu, you're a mountain in its own season, extra solid. In love you are loyal, protective and slow to start. You don't flirt so much as stay. Once you choose someone you're there for years, and that steadiness is rare. The risk is stillness that reads as distance. Your partner might need words, not just presence. You need someone patient enough to climb, and you need to send a few signals down the slope. Say the warm thing out loud.

Lovers born in the Earth days tend to be the steady one in every relationship. Make sure someone is steadying you, too.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Mu, being there is love. Saying so is love they can hear.

base.how-you-fall: You fall by tending. Gi is the garden soil, the field that feeds everything planted in it. You notice what someone needs before they do: the snack, the charger, the reassurance after a bad day at work. Caring for them is how you realize you like them, often after you've already been doing it for weeks. Your love is warm, attentive and incredibly practical. Partners feel looked after in a way that's rare. The danger is that you can confuse being needed with being loved. You might fall for people who need a lot of tending, because being useful feels safe, and slowly end up doing the emotional housework for two. Ask yourself early: if I stopped helping, would they still want me here? With the right person, the answer is an obvious yes.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Gi, you love like a garden. Patient, nurturing, everyone around you just grows.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You also love like an unpaid personal assistant. With overtime.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You're so caring! People feel completely at home with you.

spring.intro:
Wood owns the spring, and Wood controls Earth. Born in spring, a Gi Earth is the field at planting time, with every seed asking for space, so you learned to make room for others early. In love you are nurturing and practical, and you notice what a partner needs before they say it. The pressure of the season can make you accommodating to a fault. You let the other person set the pace, the plans and the tone, then feel overlooked and are not sure why. Fire, your resource, steadies you: warmth, appreciation, your own goals given equal sunlight. Good soil is not just there to be used. It is what makes the garden possible.

Spring-born lovers tend to fall at the start of things: new jobs, new cities, new seasons. Notice whether you love the person or the fresh start they arrived with.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Spring Gi, you said 'whatever you want' four times this week. What do you want?

summer.intro:
With Fire in command and Fire feeding Earth, a summer-born Gi Earth is warm, fertile ground. You are a deeply caring lover with real confidence in your instincts. You make a home of any relationship: snacks in the car, a playlist for their bad day, gentle advice delivered at exactly the right moment. With so much support behind you, the risk is over-managing. You can start organizing your partner's life because you can see what would help, and help turns into control without either of you noticing. Metal is the element you produce, and in love it means clean boundaries. Offer care, then let them choose whether to take it. That choice is intimacy too.

Summer-born lovers tend to love at full volume. Pace yourself, because the best relationships for you are the ones that stay warm in winter too.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Summer Gi, your care is a gift. Gifts don't come with instructions. Let them choose.

autumn.intro:
Metal owns the autumn, and Earth produces Metal. A Gi Earth born in autumn is the field after harvest: generous, tired and still giving. You love by producing results. You remember the details, solve the problems, make the relationship run smoothly, and you are proud of that. But a field that keeps giving without rest gets thin. You can slip into being your partner's assistant rather than their lover, then quietly resent it. Your resource is Fire, which means delight, compliments, plans made purely for your enjoyment. Let someone take care of you without having earned it first. Love does not need to be a fair trade every single week.

Autumn-born lovers tend to be selective and slow to commit, then deeply loyal. Let people earn your trust, but don't make the test impossible.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Autumn Gi, you planned their birthday, their mom's and the dog's. Who's planning yours?

winter.intro:
Water owns the winter, and Earth controls Water. A winter-born Gi Earth is cold, damp ground, full of potential but waiting for warmth. You are thoughtful and private in love. You prefer to watch a person for a long time before you trust them, and you hold a surprising amount of emotion under a calm surface. Because the season is cold, you can doubt whether you are interesting enough, so you stay helpful instead of being vulnerable. Fire is what your chart craves: someone who seeks you out, who is playful, who makes plans with obvious excitement. When someone warms you, you become the richest soil in the garden. Let yourself be wanted.

Winter-born lovers tend to love quietly and deeply. Say it out loud more often than feels necessary. It rarely is too often.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Winter Gi, you don't have to be useful to be wanted. Some people just want you.

earth.intro:
You arrived in the Earth days, Gi, so your own element is in full command. Garden soil at its richest: you love by nurturing. Food, comfort, remembering, quietly making their life easier. People feel safe with you fast. The risk is that you give care instead of asking for it, then feel unseen. You need a partner who tends you back, not just one who grows in your garden. Practice receiving. When they offer, say yes and thank you, and nothing else.

Lovers born in the Earth days tend to be the steady one in every relationship. Make sure someone is steadying you, too.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Gi, 'oh, you didn't have to' is not a love language. Say thank you.

base.how-you-fall: Your way of falling is like a sword is drawn: decisively and with commitment. Gyeong is raw metal, the axe, the blade that has to be forged. You don't do vague. You know pretty quickly if you're interested, and once you are, you pursue with clarity. No games, no hints, just "I like you, let's go to dinner." This directness is refreshing and a little intimidating. You fall for strength, honesty and people who don't fold the first time you push back. Respect comes first. Without it, attraction dies fast. When you love, you love loyally and protectively, the kind of partner who would fight the world for their person. The catch is that you can treat love a bit like a mission, and a mission sometimes forgets to stop and enjoy the view.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Gyeong, you love like a sword. Loyal, protective, you'd fight the whole world for your person.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You'd also fight your person. About how they load the dishwasher.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You're just honest! Your compliments actually mean something.

spring.intro:
In spring Wood takes the lead, and Metal controls Wood. Born in spring, a Gyeong Metal is an axe walking into a forest, surrounded by work to be done. In love you are action first: you pursue clearly, you protect fiercely, and you prove feelings through effort. The season gives you a lot to chase, which can make romance feel like a goal to achieve. You can win someone over and then lose interest in the maintenance, or treat their needs like tasks on a list. Earth, your resource, slows you down usefully: routine, patience, a partner who feels like home base. The bravest thing a warrior can do in love is stop working and simply stay.

Spring-born lovers tend to fall at the start of things: new jobs, new cities, new seasons. Notice whether you love the person or the fresh start they arrived with.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Spring Gyeong, you won them. Congratulations. Now the relationship starts, and it isn't a quest.

summer.intro:
Fire owns the summer, and Fire controls Metal. A summer-born Gyeong is iron in the forge: heated, pressured and, if it holds, tempered into something remarkable. In love you may have been drawn to intense, passionate people who test you. Arguments can feel like trials of strength, and you hate losing them. The forge gives you resilience and loyalty, but it can also make you brace for conflict even in calm relationships. Your answer is a partner who is steady rather than dramatic, and conversations that cool before they become verdicts. Strong does not have to mean unbreakable. You are allowed to soften.

Summer-born lovers tend to love at full volume. Pace yourself, because the best relationships for you are the ones that stay warm in winter too.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Summer Gyeong, you survived every fire. You don't need new ones to prove it.

autumn.intro:
Metal leads the autumn, so an autumn-born Gyeong is the blade at its sharpest. You love with total loyalty and total honesty, often in the same blunt sentence. You know what you want, you say it, and you expect the same in return. That clarity is attractive and slightly intimidating. With doubled Metal, your blind spot is rigidity. You decide what a partner meant and stop listening, or you treat a small slip as a betrayal of principle. Fire refines Metal, and Water lets it flow. In love that means warmth and softness: a partner who melts your certainty a little, and a willingness to say 'tell me more' before 'that's wrong'.

Autumn-born lovers tend to be selective and slow to commit, then deeply loyal. Let people earn your trust, but don't make the test impossible.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Autumn Gyeong, you're right a lot. You're also lonely a lot. Those might be connected.

winter.intro:
Water owns the winter, and Metal produces Water. A winter-born Gyeong Metal is a blade cooling in a river: sharp but quietly drained by the cold current. You give a lot of yourself in love, often through advice, problem solving and protecting people from things they never knew happened. You may come across as emotionally cool when you are actually feeling a great deal and expressing none of it. Pouring yourself out without warmth leaves you rusty and withdrawn. Earth, your resource, and Fire, your refiner, both help: a reliable partner, a warm home, someone who tells you plainly that you matter. A blade that is cared for stays bright.

Winter-born lovers tend to love quietly and deeply. Say it out loud more often than feels necessary. It rarely is too often.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Winter Gyeong, you protect everyone so quietly. Let one person know what it costs you.

earth.intro:
The Earth days feed Metal, and you were born in them, Gyeong. Ore inside a mountain: well supported, very sure of yourself. In love you are protective, loyal and direct. You show care through action and defend your person fiercely. The risk is that you're hard to reach emotionally, and arguments turn into verdicts. You need a partner who can stand their ground and still be soft with you. Try ending one disagreement with a question instead of a conclusion.

Lovers born in the Earth days tend to be the steady one in every relationship. Make sure someone is steadying you, too.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Gyeong would fight the world for you. Gyeong could also just hug you.

base.how-you-fall: You fall for the details. Sin is the jewel, the polished silver ring, metal that has already been refined into something beautiful. You notice how someone dresses, how they speak to waiters, whether they text in full sentences. Taste matters to you more than you'd admit. When someone passes your many quiet tests, you fall gracefully and with real tenderness. You make love feel elegant and special, like being invited into a beautiful room. Underneath the polish, though, you're sensitive. A careless comment can stay with you for weeks, and you might pull back before you're hurt, just in case. You also fall for an idea of perfection sometimes, and real people, with their messy kitchens and odd habits, can never quite match it. Let them be imperfect. So are you.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Sin, you love like a jewel. Elegant, thoughtful, everything you touch feels special.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: And you judged their font choice in the group chat. Don't lie.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You have beautiful taste! People feel honored to be chosen by you.

spring.intro:
Born while Wood rules, and with Metal controlling Wood, a spring-born Sin Metal is a jewel set in a garden, beautiful and constantly evaluating the blossoms around it. You have high standards in love and you are not shy about them. You notice the outfit, the grammar, the way someone treats the waiter. The season keeps you busy pursuing and choosing, which can make dating feel like curating. Many promising people are dismissed for a small flaw. Earth, your resource, gives you security, and with security comes generosity. When you trust that you are valued, you relax your rules and let someone be imperfect and lovely at the same time.

Spring-born lovers tend to fall at the start of things: new jobs, new cities, new seasons. Notice whether you love the person or the fresh start they arrived with.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Spring Sin, you ghosted them over their font choice. Yes, I saw. Give imperfection one more date.

summer.intro:
Summer puts Fire in command, and Fire controls Metal. A jewel left in the summer heat feels the pressure most, so a summer-born Sin Metal is sensitive, precise and quick to feel judged. In love you crave admiration but flinch from criticism, and intense, demanding partners can leave you feeling scratched. You often test people to see whether they will still treat you gently when you are difficult. The heat also gives you depth and resilience you rarely credit yourself with. Earth softens Fire and protects the gem, so look for steady, patient love rather than dramatic passion. You sparkle brightest in shade, with someone who handles you with care.

Summer-born lovers tend to love at full volume. Pace yourself, because the best relationships for you are the ones that stay warm in winter too.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Summer Sin, you're precious, not fragile. Choose someone gentle enough to know the difference.

autumn.intro:
In autumn Metal takes the lead, so an autumn-born Sin is a jewel in its element, polished and certain of its worth. In love you are discerning, elegant and quietly proud. You know exactly the kind of devotion you deserve, and you are not afraid to walk away from anything less. With doubled Metal, the blind spot is perfectionism and coolness. You can withhold affection to make a point, or expect a partner to read your standards without being told. Water, your output element, washes a jewel until it gleams. In love that is open expression: telling them what pleases you, what hurts, what you want next. Mystery attracts. Clarity keeps.

Autumn-born lovers tend to be selective and slow to commit, then deeply loyal. Let people earn your trust, but don't make the test impossible.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Autumn Sin, your silent treatment is beautifully executed. It's still a silent treatment. Use words.

winter.intro:
Water rules winter, and Metal produces Water. Classical saju says Sin Metal loves to be washed by clear water, so a winter-born Sin is a gem in a cold stream: luminous, articulate and a little chilled. You express feelings with precision. Your texts are thoughtful and your compliments land. But giving so much through words can leave you emotionally thin, and the cold season makes you private about needing comfort. You may pull back exactly when you most want closeness. Earth, your resource, means security, and Fire brings warmth. A partner who offers both, a steady presence and an obvious delight in you, lets you sparkle without shivering.

Winter-born lovers tend to love quietly and deeply. Say it out loud more often than feels necessary. It rarely is too often.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Winter Sin, you write the loveliest messages. Let someone warm you up in return.

earth.intro:
Earth-days Sin, you're a jewel in rich ground. Earth feeds Metal, but heavy soil can hide a gem, and you sometimes hide your wants to keep things pleasant. In love you're refined, thoughtful and noticeably selective. You show care through details. The risk is waiting for your person to read standards you've never said. You need a partner who appreciates precision and asks what matters to you. Then you need to answer, honestly, the first time they ask.

Lovers born in the Earth days tend to be the steady one in every relationship. Make sure someone is steadying you, too.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Sin, they can't meet a standard you've kept secret.

base.how-you-fall: You fall like a wave: big, sudden and with a pull that surprises everyone, including you. Im is the ocean, the great river, water that moves and refuses to stay still. You're drawn to people who make life feel bigger, the ones who talk about moving to Lisbon on a whim or who can keep up with your curiosity at 2am. You fall through adventure and ideas. A great conversation is your favorite kind of date. The first phase with you is thrilling: spontaneous trips, deep talks, the feeling of being swept up. The trouble comes when the tide turns into routine. You love freedom, and any whiff of being contained can make you drift. That's not because you don't care. It's because oceans need room. Find someone who swims, not someone who builds a pool.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Im, you love like the ocean. Big, adventurous, people feel swept away by you.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: And then the tide goes out and they're standing alone on the beach.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You just need freedom! You never try to change anyone.

spring.intro:
In spring Wood takes the lead, and Water feeds Wood. A spring-born Im Water is a river in flood season, pouring life into everything on its banks. In love you are generous, curious and expansive. You give ideas, adventures and long late-night conversations that change people. The season draws your energy outward, which is lovely for others and draining for you. You can pour yourself into someone's growth and then feel oddly empty, or drift toward the next interesting person when the first one stops being a discovery. Metal, your resource, refills you: structure, commitment, someone with a clear sense of self. Rivers need banks. They are what make the water go somewhere.

Spring-born lovers tend to fall at the start of things: new jobs, new cities, new seasons. Notice whether you love the person or the fresh start they arrived with.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Spring Im, you inspired them, mentored them and left. That's a TED talk, not a relationship.

summer.intro:
Fire owns the summer, and Water controls Fire. A summer-born Im Water is the sea in August: warm on the surface, working hard underneath. In love you are drawn to passionate, bright, dramatic people, and you spend a lot of energy managing their heat. You cool down arguments, rescue plans and keep everything moving. That can make you feel powerful, and also quietly spent, as if you are always containing something. Water evaporates in summer. Metal, your resource, restores you: a partner with principles, time alone, conversations where you are not the one keeping the peace. Choose love that refreshes you instead of love you have to keep putting out.

Summer-born lovers tend to love at full volume. Pace yourself, because the best relationships for you are the ones that stay warm in winter too.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Summer Im, you calm everyone's fires. It's okay to want someone who brings you water.

autumn.intro:
Autumn belongs to Metal, and Metal feeds Water. An autumn-born Im Water is a river gathering strength from mountain springs: clear, powerful and deeply supported. In love you are confident and free. You want a partner who can keep up intellectually and give you plenty of space, and you can disappear for days into your own currents without thinking it matters. With so much resource behind you, your blind spot is overwhelming the people you love with your intensity, opinions or need for freedom. Wood, your output, channels you into warmth and play. Earth, your controller, gives you a shape. A little structure makes the current feel like an embrace instead of a flood.

Autumn-born lovers tend to be selective and slow to commit, then deeply loyal. Let people earn your trust, but don't make the test impossible.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Autumn Im, 'I need my space' for a fortnight isn't freedom. It's vanishing with good branding.

winter.intro:
In winter Water takes the lead, so a winter-born Im is the ocean at its deepest. You love with immense depth, intuition and a slightly overwhelming sense of meaning. When you are in, you are fully in, and you can make a partner feel they are the only person you have ever understood. Doubled Water also brings mood tides. You might go from intensely present to strangely distant without warning, and assume they understand why. Earth gives Water direction, and Fire brings warmth to a cold sea. In love that means consistency and lightness: regular plans, playful dates, explaining your silences before they become stories in someone else's head.

Winter-born lovers tend to love quietly and deeply. Say it out loud more often than feels necessary. It rarely is too often.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Winter Im, your love runs deep and mostly underwater. Just tell them when the tide goes out.

earth.intro:
You were born in the Earth days, Im, when the ground takes command and water meets its banks. Earth controls Water, so in love you swing between wanting freedom and wanting something that holds you. You're generous, curious and full of big ideas for the two of you. The risk is pulling away the moment it feels like a rule. You need a partner who gives you shape without boxing you in. Talk about structure early, so it feels chosen, not imposed.

Lovers born in the Earth days tend to be the steady one in every relationship. Make sure someone is steadying you, too.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Im, a riverbank isn't a cage. It's how the river gets somewhere.

base.how-you-fall: You fall like mist settles: quietly, gradually, and then everything is soft and changed. Gye is the rain, the dew, the gentle water that soaks into everything. You don't fall for loud people. You fall for someone who feels like a secret, someone whose inner world seems as layered as yours. Often you fall in your imagination first, writing whole stories about a person before you've had a proper conversation. Your love is romantic, intuitive and deeply emotional. You sense what your partner feels before they say it. The danger is that your imagination can be more beautiful than reality, and you might stay loyal to a dream long after the actual person stopped showing up for it. Love the real one, too, not just the one in your head.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Gye, you love like soft rain. Gentle, romantic, you feel everything they feel.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You also wrote a whole love story about someone you've spoken to twice.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You're just so intuitive! Your playlists are love letters.

spring.intro:
Spring belongs to Wood, and Water nourishes Wood. A spring-born Gye Water is spring rain: gentle, intuitive and constantly feeding the growth around it. In love you are the person who quietly supports. You encourage dreams, listen deeply and seem to know what someone needs before they do. The season pulls your energy outward, so you can give until you feel invisible. You may hide your own wants because the other person's seem more important. What steadies you is self-respect: your own values, your own routines, a partner who asks about your plans and remembers the answer. Rain is necessary for every garden. You are allowed to want to be the garden too.

Spring-born lovers tend to fall at the start of things: new jobs, new cities, new seasons. Notice whether you love the person or the fresh start they arrived with.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Spring Gye, you listened for three hours. They didn't ask one question. Notice that.

summer.intro:
With Fire in command and Water controlling Fire, a summer-born Gye Water is a summer shower: brief, refreshing and gone before anyone can thank it. In love you are drawn to warm, magnetic people, and you are good at cooling their tempers and softening their intensity. But a light rain in July evaporates fast. You can disappear into a partner's bright personality, feel unseen, and leave quietly rather than ask for more. What steadies you is clarity about what you need, plus friends, quiet evenings and reflection. You are not just their relief. You deserve to be someone's whole weather report.

Summer-born lovers tend to love at full volume. Pace yourself, because the best relationships for you are the ones that stay warm in winter too.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Summer Gye, you're not their break from the heat. You're the person they should be thrilled by.

autumn.intro:
Autumn hands command to Metal, the mother of Water. An autumn-born Gye is morning dew on cool stone: clear, perceptive and supported from beneath. In love your intuition is excellent. You sense a mood shift through a screen and can tell if someone is fibbing by how they type. With so much resource, your blind spot is living in your head. You build a whole relationship in imagination, testing scenarios and interpretations, while the real person waits to hear from you. Wood, your output element, turns intuition into action: saying the feeling, making the plan, being a little bold. Your read on people is usually right. Now let them read you.

Autumn-born lovers tend to be selective and slow to commit, then deeply loyal. Let people earn your trust, but don't make the test impossible.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Autumn Gye, the whole relationship already happened in your head. They haven't been told yet.

winter.intro:
In winter Water takes the lead, so a winter-born Gye is snow and mist: quiet, mysterious and deeper than it looks. You feel love intensely and show it subtly. Partners often fall for your enigma, then struggle to tell whether you are into them. You can retreat into fog when you feel exposed, and doubled Water makes you sensitive to the smallest change in tone. Fire, which is your wealth element, warms you into play and confidence, while Earth gives you steady ground to land on. In love that looks like a dependable, affectionate partner and the courage to state your interest plainly. Mystery is lovely. Being understood is lovelier.

Winter-born lovers tend to love quietly and deeply. Say it out loud more often than feels necessary. It rarely is too often.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Winter Gye, you're a beautiful mystery. Give them one clear clue tonight.

earth.intro:
Earth days end every season, Gye, and you were born in them. Rain on dry ground: Earth controls Water, so a lot of what you feel sinks in and never shows. In love you're intuitive, tender and attentive to every shift. You know what they need before they do. The risk is that nobody knows what you need, because you've absorbed it quietly. You need a partner who asks, and asks again. Meet them halfway by saying one feeling before you're sure of it.

Lovers born in the Earth days tend to be the steady one in every relationship. Make sure someone is steadying you, too.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Gye, you don't have to be certain to say how you feel.
